description: Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka - The Collective Investment Scheme (CIS) Code (E only)
categorisation: This gazette contains rules made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 19 of 2021. It establishes the Collective Investment Scheme Code (CIS Code), which is a comprehensive regulatory framework governing collective investment schemes. The content consists entirely of legal/regulatory provisions, including sections on scheme establishment, trustee requirements, marketing rules, investment limitations, and reporting requirements, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
